A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TKG-DM work, with all ten pages readable and comparable, including equations, figures, tables and references. Neither contains an appendix or embedded supplement; supplementary material referenced in both versions is absent from the supplied files.

before.justification: v1 reports original MAGICK image-generation evaluations, ControlNet experiments and a 100-participant preference study, with outcomes in Tables 1–2 and Figure 8.

after.justification: v2 retains the original image-generation experiments, quantitative evaluations and user-study outcomes reported in v1.

M1.justification: The channel mean shift, Gaussian-mask noise blending and application procedures are unchanged. Sections 3 and 6 retain the same method components and integrations.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same MAGICK foreground-generation data and retain the same color-control, ControlNet, layout-aware generation, consistency-model and text-to-video demonstrations.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains SD1.5/SDXL with Green Background Prompt, GB LoRA, DeepFloyd and LayerDiffuse. Table 2 retains the same ControlNet comparison, and the user study retains SDXL with Green Background Prompt and LayerDiffuse.

E3.justification: The 3,000-image sample, generation resolutions, 50 DDIM steps, guidance scale of 7.5, evaluation metrics and two-alternative user-study design are unchanged, including the stated image and participant counts.

E4.justification: The channel-shift and color-mixing tests in Figure 3, attention-map analysis in Figure 4, and failure cases involving small foregrounds and prompts lacking objects in Figure 11 are identical.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates and user-study sample information. Neither supplies experimental seed or repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative examples are unchanged. TKG-DM's SD1.5 FID/m-FID remain 56.32/40.75 in Table 1; its user preferences remain 53.9% against SDXL with Green Background Prompt and 50.1% against LayerDiffuse in Figure 8.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(3), the positive-ratio definitions and Gaussian-mask formulation are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same novelty claims, training-free foreground/background control contribution, performance claims against fine-tuned methods and extensions to other generative tasks.

C2.justification: The attention-based mechanism explanation, interpretations of LayerDiffuse and DeepFloyd's evaluation advantages, and limitations concerning very small foregrounds and background generation remain unchanged in Sections 4, 5.4 and 7.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, Gaussian-mask parameters, preprocessing, dataset descriptions and model-access links are unchanged. No additional code, hardware, runtime or reproducibility information is supplied.

R1.justification: Both versions contain the same 56 references and the same related-work discussion, including their positioning relative to MAGICK, LayerDiffuse and initial-noise manipulation methods.

P1.justification: The acknowledgements add BMDV NITD funding, grant 45KI22B021, alongside the existing SustainML acknowledgement. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; the scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 removes the printed page-number footers and boldfaces the 'Ours' label in Table 2. Figures, table structures, captions and their placement otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 adds a funding credit and makes small formatting edits while preserving the method, evidence, claims, limitations and reproducibility information. The fuller acknowledgement does not materially change the paper's scientific support, explanatory clarity or overall quality.
